services.name: Lesson Plan Submission
services.desc: Our local history is worth sharing! Our historic Deere family homes serve as resources for local teachers. We are excited to partner with local educators to create lesson plans for local history topics for elementary, middle and high school students. We're looking for Discover and Dig Deeper levels of lesson plans. Our Discover level is a basic recipe for what a lesson would include and the Dig Deeper level is a comprehensive lesson plan narrative. As our collaborators, we are offering $50 for the Discover level lesson plan and another $200 for the Dig Deeper lesson plan associated with the Discover topic. Use the Lesson Plan Submission Form to send your plans

services.desc: Planning an off-site event for your company? Looking for a one-of-a-kind venue to inspire your team and impress guests? Consider Butterworth Center, a spacious Victorian mansion in the heart of Moline, home over a century ago to Katherine (Deere) and William Butterworth. Their home-once called Hillcrest and now known as Butterworth Center-was used frequently by the couple for entertaining business clients as the farm implement company grew under William’s leadership. blurb: Welcome to Butterworth Center & Deere-Wiman House, located in the Overlook District of Moline, Illinois. Both historic homes once belonged to John Deere's descendants but are now operated by the William Butterworth Foundation.
